title: EIP-8261: Gas Limit Schedule
description: Recommend an optional post-Gloas consensus layer gas limit schedule for epoch-based defaults and maximum recommendations.
author: Barnabas Busa (@barnabasbusa)
laymanDescription: Adds an optional list of gas limit changes by epoch to consensus client config. Validators who never set their own preference adopt the scheduled value at the right time, so raising the network's gas limit no longer depends on operators installing a new release first.
benefits: Separates shipping a new gas limit default from activating it
Gives the network one machine-readable record of the intended gas limit
Nodes switch at the scheduled epoch with no restart or follow-up release
Optional and fork-free, so clients can adopt it independently
tradeoffs: Purely advisory; nothing stops a proposer from exceeding the scheduled value
Coordination benefit scales with adoption; non-adopting clients keep manual coordination
An error in a scheduled value would propagate widely across validators
